title: A bit confusing? But it does what it’s supposed to!
text:
Bought 2 of these packs for my team as a thank you, so spent a fair amount of money. Went to check the Chipotle website for balances (just in case, I had read the reviews on these cards and wanted to be safe), and none of the cards were active according to the website or couldn’t be found. Called Amazon Customer Support (they were a bit unhelpful honestly) and they told me to go to a Chipotle store to have them check/activate the cards. The Chipotle employee swiped each and they were fully active, correct amounts, and ready for use (they can only activate cards purchased in store and from the company itself).
TLDR: Don’t use the Chipotle website to check, go to a store or call their support if you want to check. Also, to clarify for some people, you can’t use a gift card as a partial payment online (like most retailers)! You can do this in store, but online is a no go.

I was shocked!

I wasnt prepared for that with my credit card especially after the holidays, so of course it declined the extra 200.00 I was expecting the gift cards to have covered....
and I wanted to use the 300.00 in gift cards, not my credit card on my account from previous use of Amazon.

I called customer service and kept getting a woman who I could not understand, telling me the same thing over and over as if she was reading from a script to me, telling me she couldnt help me and would forward my issue to another department and they would get back with me by email within 12 hours.

I get an email later stating i need to choose another payment method, as my credit card delined! UM, DUH! I didnt wish to use my card, I wanted to use the gift card balance!!

So, I wrote to explain this back to them and no answer, it has been a week, and my order was cancelled.

I still have a 300.00 gift card balance but cant use it for the 300.00 item I wanted only can use 100.00 at a time! RETARDED!

This is the 3rd issue with amazon gift cards I have encountered!

title: Difficult to use
text: The price was good and even sweeter combined with hotels.com’s rewards for extra night. However, hotels.com’s gift card interface is very difficult to use. First, you have to enter from the gift card section of the website to search and make bookings if you want to use gift cards, which can be cumbersome. It’s easier to apply points using their app. Second, not all bookings allow gift card use, and when you want to use it they deduct points right away even if the booking is still within free cancellation time. No option to pay later. When you cancel they issue you a new card number instead of putting the balance back to the old card, and it says it could take couple hours. In my experience the refund is issued within minutes. Lastly, their website tool for combining and viewing gift card balance is constantly down and you have to call them to do this simple function.

title: Complicated and Confusing
text: I had previously written a review on these types of cards under the guidelines for the reviews. HOWEVER, it was rejected since it was not covering an item. But alas it was. I had requested a refund on two items and while I received an email that the refund was processed, shortly thereafter I got another email for an amazon gift card and what was the amount I wanted on it. I followed the steps thinking it would be credited to my debit card (which I had used for the original payment) but instead loaded it unto an amazon gift card and took double the original amount. As quick as they are to take the money out of my account, it still took 3-5 business days to get my money back. If you are issuing a refund to the original card used, do not complicate the process by then sending an email for an amazon gift card that was neither wanted or requested. The refund process should be clear and remove the amazon gift card email if that is not what is requested or wanted by the client.
